name: Call Desk
tagline: Makes the phone calls you keep putting off

source.excerpt: Shared as a desk that takes on the calls its owner would rather not make.

body:
## What it does

Hand it an errand and it dials out on your behalf: ringing a shop to check stock, booking a table or an appointment, querying a line on a utility bill, or chasing a parcel that never turned up. Speech and telephony are wired together behind the scenes, so a real call is placed and you are told what was said. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @dave_dlt shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
